heroTitle: People, community and the land we farm
heroLead: We take our role as employer, community member and custodian of the environment to heart.

employeeCards.title: More than a salary
employeeCards.text: Mahela Group is accredited with SIZA, which certifies compliance with ethical labour and environmental practices. Our responsibility as an employer goes beyond merely paying our employees a salary.

employeeCards.title: Training programmes
employeeCards.text: Ongoing training programmes such as computer, life skills training and adult literacy classes empower employees to improve their standard of living.

employeeCards.title: Crèche and school
employeeCards.text: Working moms can focus on their careers, knowing that toddlers are well looked after by trained personnel in a Mahela Group crèche. With an on-farm primary school, their children need not walk long distances.

employeeCards.title: A healthy, balanced life
employeeCards.text: Mahela Group promotes a healthy and well-balanced life by organising and sponsoring events such as soccer tournaments, fishing and cycling competitions.

employeeCards.title: Vegetable tunnels
employeeCards.text: Vegetable tunnels were erected on farms. Workers are supplied with everything they need to produce vegetables for themselves and their families.

communityText: As one of the pioneering enterprises in the Lowveld, Mahela Group has and always will play a crucial role in the socio-economic well-being of the region. Apart from providing employment in a province where the unemployment and poverty rate is one of the highest in South Africa, the Group supports various non-profit entities and schools.

One of these schools, the Junction primary school, is funded almost entirely by the Mahela Group, who also provided the land the school is built on. At the school, children are given the opportunity to get a good education, thanks to properly trained teachers, safe, functioning facilities and resources.
schoolCardText: Funded almost entirely by Mahela, on land Mahela provided
ctaTitle: Partner with a grower that cares.
ctaText: Ethically grown, SIZA-accredited fruit from a company invested in its people, its community and the land.
seoDescription: How Mahela Group cares for its employees, community and environment: SIZA accreditation, training, an on-farm crèche and school, the Khomanani Mahela farmer project, integrated pest management and wildlife conservation.
